points.point: Does a 429 response include a Retry-After header?
Does a 429 response include an X-RateLimit-Remaining header?

verdict.reason: The closest entry, rate-limit, covers workflow "Too many requests" messages and says to wait for the retry interval when the response supplies one, but none of its sentences say whether a 429 response includes a Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Remaining header, so the customer's header question is unanswered.
